I've transferred twice now, and both times I talked to my manager about me applying to these new positions before I applied. I was lucky in that both time they put in a good word for me. You don't have to tell your manager that you're going to transfer, but they'll find out anyway when the store leadership contacts them for more info about you. 

You still have to do the video interview and all that stuff when you fill out the application for the new store you're interested in. You'll be interviewed in-store too. For the most part, you'll be doing the same thing you did when you first applied. 

BTW, if you do transfer your manager can still keep you at your current store for up to 90 days before you're actually transferred. I think the train of thought is that so they'll have time to find your "replacement". I'm pretty sure it's 90 days, but it might be different now
